scripts.dev: npm run build:sw:reset &&pnpm seedLocalD1 && wrangler dev
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api:all && npm run test:ui:all
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:api:success && npm run test:ui:success
scripts.test:unit: jest --testPathIgnorePatterns=tests/api.test.js tests/ui.spec.js tests/api.success.test.js tests/api.errors.test.js tests/ui.success.spec.js tests/ui.edge-cases.spec.js
scripts.test:unit:watch: jest --testPathIgnorePatterns=tests/api.test.js tests/ui.spec.js tests/api.success.test.js tests/api.errors.test.js tests/ui.success.spec.js tests/ui.edge-cases.spec.js --watch
scripts.test:success: npm run test:api:success && npm run test:ui:success
scripts.test:errors: npm run test:api:errors && npm run test:ui:edge-cases
scripts.test:watch: jest --watch --testPathIgnorePatterns=tests/api.test.js tests/ui.spec.js tests/api.success.test.js tests/api.errors.test.js tests/ui.success.spec.js tests/ui.edge-cases.spec.js
scripts.coverage:report: jest --coverage --coverageReporters=html && echo 'Coverage report generated in coverage/lcov-report/index.html'
